results.name: Heckler & Koch USP Pistol
results.description: This is my second model i release using blender as modeling software. Last time i was too lazy to bake high poly normals to my model so this time i took the time to make both high poly and low poly model. I used substance painter and photoshop for texturing.

results.name: HK MP5 SMG
results.description:
I'm excited to share my latest project a game-ready 3D model of the iconic HK MP5 submachine gun. The journey of bringing this firearm to life was all about precision. Dive into the photorealistic 4K textures and the 16K vertices optimized for game engines.
Also checkout my [Artstation](http://www.artstation.com/danielzamary) and support me for more.
Download and enjoy!

results.name: Hollow Knight - Pure Nail
results.description:
Hollow Knight sculpt based on the Pure nail.

Players often take ages to finish HK due to all the side content and dlc. 
So I wondered what a nail with that many hours on it would look like. The fully upgraded nail of a seasoned Hollow Knight.

Done in Blender and Zbrush, was a ton of fun and a great learning exercise!

results.name: Pistol Concept
results.description:
Pistol Concept i made in my free time. Special purpose pistol inspired by her majesty from Cyberpunk 2077 and by HK mk.23 (Kept you waitin huh?)

Made in Plasticity, blender, SP, Marmoset

Topology is a bit messy, because i just decimated CAD model a bit, but since this is a concept, and not  production model, whatever

Sybyr means whisper in kazakh, if you were wondering, i just named it like that

You may use it in your commercial/ non-commercial games or mods however you like, just give me credit, please.

My artstation:https://www.artstation.com/diamonddogkz (Please like my posts)

results.name: Low-Poly FN P90
results.description:
The FN P90 is a PDW bullpup. The gun has a strange magazine and a very sci-fi design.

The gun was in direct competition with the HK MP7 as a lightweight compact firearm with the combined traits of an SMG and a Carbine/Assault Rifle.
